rationale: Last step of Val/Ile biosynthesis (KEGG lists only K00826 for it); Prochlorococcus makes all 20 amino acids [interpretation]. Not blind for MED4 (pilot). Single-KO step: an alternative enzyme (e.g. tyrB K00832 for Leu, avtA K00835 for Val) would be invisible here.

Histidine biosynthesis has no route around this transamination; KEGG M00026 lists only K00817. Not blind for MED4 (pilot). Some bacteria carry HisC activity on other class I ATs, which this KO list would miss.
Aspartate is made by transamination of oxaloacetate [interpretation]; all KEGG KOs for EC 2.6.1.1 included. Not blind for MED4 (pilot: PMM0674 on K00812).
Tryptophanase (indole production) is described from enteric and other heterotrophic bacteria; no report places it in cyanobacteria [interpretation]. A hit is more likely a KO artefact.
Tyrosine phenol-lyase is known from enterobacteria (e.g. Citrobacter, Erwinia) and insect symbionts; not cyanobacteria [interpretation].
The AST arginine pathway is a proteobacterial (E. coli, Pseudomonas) route [interpretation].
